name: Panic Plastics, Inc.
old_description: Panic Plastics, Inc. Your Own Thermoforming Division At The End Of Your Phone!
about:
Panic Plastics, Inc. operates from Payette, Idaho, where it has served as a thermoforming specialist for over 35 years. The company was founded to provide custom plastic packaging solutions, though the exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs, develops, and manufactures thermoformed plastic packaging including clamshell packages, blister packs, and thermoformed trays. It also produces printed blister cards and clamshell insert cards, and supplies blister and clamshell sealing equipment. Capabilities span thermoform design, tooling, and production, with a stock packaging program that eliminates mold costs and enables next-day shipment on standard items.

Panic Plastics serves a broad range of industries that require plastic packaging, working with nationally recognized brands across diverse sectors. Its customer base includes companies seeking both custom-engineered packaging and off-the-shelf stock solutions.

The company's stated mission is to manufacture the finest quality thermoformed packaging while delivering competitive pricing and on-time delivery. Core values emphasize respectful workplace conduct, ethical behavior, continuous improvement, and treating customers right. Panic Plastics positions itself as a full-service partner from initial design through high-tech tooling and manufacturing.
